The '''YI-5 Surveillance/[[Interrogation droid/Legends|Interrogation droid]]''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] shaped approximately like a [[Remote/Legends|remote]], with a hovering, approximately spherical body. In addition to conducting interrogation semi-autonomously, a YI-5 droid could track down a subject in the manner of a [[seeker]]. Such droids were fitted with stealth fields that enabled them to blend in with the approximate color of their surroundings.<ref name="Center of the Empire" />

This type of droid was commonly employed by the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|ISB]] during the days of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Center of the Empire" />
